name: bermudan_optimal_stopping
seed_description: official Ridge LSMC baseline feature program
candidate_instructions: Modify only feature_program.json and submit only the bounded data-only openhyra-feature-program.v1 IR.
Do not add Python, reported prices, stopping decisions, paths, seeds, confidence intervals, or dual values.
engineering_invariants: Candidates submit only the bounded typed feature IR; model, contract, simulation, payoff, discounting, regression, stopping, and scoring remain evaluator-owned.
Policy-fit paths, out-of-sample pricing paths, dual outer paths, and dual inner draws use domain-separated random streams.
Every stopping decision uses only the current state, current exercise time, public parameters, and a policy frozen before pricing paths are generated.
The dual martingale starts at zero and uses conditionally centered one-step increments; raw empirical bound-order failures are reported and never clipped.
Search feedback uses the public suite and paired common-random-number differences against the frozen baseline; audit uses a suite derived from a sealed private seed.
fallback_directions: Add low-degree transformations of normalized underlying and intrinsic value, staying within the typed IR bounds.
Test time-to-maturity interactions with intrinsic value or normalized underlying.
Use dimension-agnostic max, mean, minimum, or basket state summaries so the feature transfers across products.
Remove redundant or unstable features and retain changes only when the paired lower-confidence-bound improves.
Combine one bounded monotone transform with one low-degree polynomial rather than expanding feature count indiscriminately.
Check whether a feature improves both one-dimensional puts and multi-asset contracts instead of overfitting one public instance.
